question: Can one continuing Brain.compose remember one of two observed token values after its cue disappears, at a fixed state size, through its working trace rather than a supplied answer or a warm numerical initial guess? The supported horizon is the largest contiguous passed prefix over 0, 1, 2 intervening accepted observations; closure needs horizon 1 and the nuisance, replacement, order, continuation, purity and resource gates.

seeds.note: fresh founders, no development founder and no seed substitution

brain.note: the declared recipe is a selected task gene (vanished_cue.make_brain unchanged: decay 0.8, amplitude 1, focus 0); the default arm keeps the composed working-trace defaults as the control of that gene

training.lesson: at the QUERY of every episode the free greedy act first, then one Learner.step on the rows it answered wrong, on the drive that act read (the surprise rule: a right answer is routine and teaches nothing); every other event is a free greedy act; a refused lesson is charged and skipped; a refused act ends the life

evaluation.seams: the first episode of every condition: after the first cue, before a replacement when present, before QUERY; a loaded clone executes the remaining observations with equal answers and equal saved arrays; private imagination and a refused act at an impossible tolerance leave the pre-query checkpoint unchanged; the restored configuration continues equally
evaluation.timing: clean-2 replayed under the regular and the irregular timestamp schedule must give equal arrays; the brain never sees a timestamp

gates.statement: for every founder, zero refused and unrun rows, intact accuracy >= intact and paired-both-correct >= paired on every clean/distractor condition of the prefix and on partial-1, noise-1, replacement-1 and order-latest-1; external-history accuracy >= history on those conditions; intact at least random_margin above the frozen uniform-random score; for each nonzero delay of the prefix, erased and reset accuracies <= lesion with intact at least lesion_margin above each; shuffled accuracy against the transplanted value >= shuffled_transplanted and against the original <= shuffled_original; the trace audit within trace_audit; every seam, imagination, refusal and timing check equal; no cap reached. The horizon is computed by the contiguous-prefix rule, never by changing floors after results; capacity 2/4 and delays 4/8 are reported without an assumed pass

policy.denominator: every planned row of every founder; a refusal is wrong and an unrun planned row is wrong
policy.selection: no default change; the trace genes are reported against the composed control

selection: recall/3, 2026-10-08: the surprise teaching rule, selected on development founders 0 and 1 against recall/2's lesson on every episode at the same trace (amplitude 0.3, decay 0.8) and budget (32 repeats): horizons 2 and none under the rule against 1 and 0 under the every rule, nothing at amplitude 1.0 under either, and the recall lost again at 64 repeats under either rule; every gate, cap, condition and control is recall/1's, declared before founders 307 to 309 ran
